name: JPC (Java Personal Computer)
description: JPC = Java Personal Computer. A computer block with a built-in x86 PC emulator that boots real ISO images inside Minecraft, no other app needed. Comes with KolibriOS.
contributors: Claude (AI assistant by Anthropic): wrote much of the code together with MengEi
The original JPC emulator (the x86 PC inside this mod): Oxford University Subdepartment of Particle Physics, Ian Preston and others, GPL-2.0
